subject: [VOTE] March 2026 Rookie PR of the Month

messages.subject: [VOTE] March 2026 Rookie PR of the Month
messages.body:
Happy Spring Season All!

Kindly take the time to celebrate your own contributions or recommend a
fellow contributor, for Rookie PR of the month.

Below is a list of Top 10 PRs for the month of March.

New Contributors - please reply to this thread with your introduction and
merged PR details. Do not hesitate to show off your  impact on the Apache
Airflow community!  Everyone is welcome to share their wins.

Voting will close on Monday, March 30th at 5 PM PST. The winner will be
featured in the next issue of the Airflow newsletter.

Warm Regards,
Srabasti Banerjee


🏆 Top 10 PRs (2026-03-01 to 2026-04-01):

 1. 🔥 PR#62664: Replace connexion with FastAPI for FAB provider
     by @1Ninad (Ninad Kale) 🆕 Rookie: PR #2, first merged 2026-03-06
     https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/62664

 2.  PR#61274: Always provide a relevant TI context in Dag callback
     by @Asquator (Asquator) 🆕 Rookie: PR #1, first merged 2026-03-08
     https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/61274

 3.  PR#63450: Adding Russian translation for UI
     by @puzzle-rpa-team (Puzzle Team) 🆕 Rookie: PR #1, first merged
2026-03-17
     https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/63450

 4.  PR#62816: added azureopenai support & extandable architecture for
pydanticai
     by @cetingokhan (Gökhan Çetin) 🆕 Rookie: PR #3, first merged
2026-02-14
     https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/62816

 5.  PR#62174: Order of task arguments in task definition causing error
when parsing DAG
     by @dsuhinin (Software Developer) 🆕 Rookie: PR #1, first merged
2026-03-23
     https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/62174

 6.  PR#61878: feat(serialization): implement truncation logic for rendered
values
     by @imrichardwu (Richard Wu) 🆕 Rookie: PR #3, first merged 2026-02-11
     https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/61878

 7.  PR#62798: Fix XCom edit modal value not repopulating on reopen.
     by @Arbaaz123676 (Arbaaz Ahmed) 🆕 Rookie: PR #1, first merged
2026-03-18
     https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/62798

 8.  PR#61483: Optimize /ui/dags endpoint serialization
     by @john-rodriguez-mgni 🆕 Rookie: PR #1, first merged 2026-03-06
     https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/61483

 9.  PR#62369: Stream grid task-instance summaries as NDJSON to eliminate
N+1 requests
     by @xvega (Xavi Vega) 🆕 Rookie: PR #1, first merged 2026-03-18
     https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/62369

10.  PR#60728: Add uv sync --no-dev before provider YAML checks
     by @Fury0508 (Dhananjay Gupta) 🆕 Rookie: PR #4, first merged
2026-03-11
     https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/60728

messages.subject: Re: [VOTE] March 2026 Rookie PR of the Month
messages.body:
Hi everyone,

*My vote: * #61274.

*My intro as a New Contributor:*
I'm Shrividya — an Apache Airflow Champion from the last cohort, now
joining as a new contributor.
I'm involved in Data Engineering and AI, having transitioned from a Senior
SDET role. I took some time getting properly acquainted with the Airflow
repo before jumping in. Lately I've been making steady contributions and
reviewing PRs and I look forward to being more active.
Excited to be part of this community!

The following are my merged PRs:
- add application name as env var to driver and executor pods for
SparkKubernetesOperator:
https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/64015

Few other doc fix PRs:
- https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/64139
- https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/63683

Thanks,
Shrividya Hegde
